labs.title: Broken Access Control
labs.description: Learn how authorization flaws allow unauthorized users to view, tamper with, or delete sensitive data.
labs.short_description: Insecure Direct Object References and multi-tenant boundary bypass.
learning_objectives: Identify flawed object-level access controls
Audit multi-tenant boundary isolation
Implement server-side authorization enforcement

labs.title: Security Misconfiguration
labs.description: Investigate default credentials, exposed debug interfaces, and unauthenticated directory listings leaking sensitive backups.
labs.short_description: Default credentials, diagnostic endpoints, and backup exposures.
learning_objectives: Identify exposed debug and diagnostic endpoints
Detect dangerous unauthenticated directory browsing
Harden default server credentials and configs

labs.title: Software Supply Chain Failures
labs.description: Understand risks from unverified third-party dependencies, malicious package scripts, and vulnerable build artifacts.
labs.short_description: Dependency poisoning, unpinned telemetry packages, and lockfile tampering.
learning_objectives: Analyze compromised package manifests and lockfiles
Trace unauthorized credential exfiltration scripts
Implement cryptographic package provenance verification

labs.title: Cryptographic Failures
labs.description: Explore the risks of legacy broken hashes (MD5), hardcoded encryption keys, and sensitive data leakage.
labs.short_description: Broken MD5 hashes, salt omissions, and rainbow table reversing.
learning_objectives: Recognize obsolete cryptographic algorithms
Understand how unsalted hashes succumb to precomputed tables
Deploy modern password hashing algorithms (Argon2/bcrypt)

labs.title: Injection
labs.description: Understand SQL injection root causes, malicious query manipulation, and parameterized query remediation.
labs.short_description: SQL query manipulation, string escaping breakout, and UNION extraction.
learning_objectives: Distinguish data from query syntax execution
Execute UNION-based database schema exfiltration
Refactor raw SQL strings into prepared statements

labs.title: Insecure Design
labs.description: Analyze flawed business logic, unverified workflow state transitions, and missing architectural security controls.
labs.short_description: Flawed procurement state transitions and missing business logic controls.
learning_objectives: Differentiate design flaws from implementation vulnerabilities
Detect illegal state transitions in enterprise workflows
Establish architectural security invariants in business logic

labs.title: Authentication Failures
labs.description: Explore how weak credential requirements, lack of brute-force protection, and session fixation lead to account takeover.
labs.short_description: Missing lockout mechanisms, predictable PINs, and automated credential stuffing.
learning_objectives: Assess authentication mechanisms against automated guessing
Identify failure modes of unrestricted login endpoints
Implement multi-layered rate limiting and progressive delays

labs.title: Software or Data Integrity Failures
labs.description: Understand vulnerabilities from accepting unverified, untrusted software or configuration artifacts without cryptographic signatures.
labs.short_description: Unsigned firmware configurations and missing digital signature verification.
learning_objectives: Evaluate the risks of accepting untrusted configuration updates
Demonstrate code/config tampering without integrity checks
Implement asymmetric signature verification for payload ingestion

labs.title: Security Logging & Alerting Failures
labs.description: Discover how insufficient security telemetry, missing audit trails, and silent failures prevent incident detection.
labs.short_description: Silent security incidents, missing privilege escalation logs, and audit blindness.
learning_objectives: Audit high-privilege operations for logging coverage
Identify blind spots that permit undetected adversary movement
Design tamper-evident structured security audit events

labs.title: Mishandling of Exceptional Conditions
labs.description: Examine dangerous fail-open exception handling where upstream service errors accidentally bypass authorization boundaries.
labs.short_description: Fail-open exception handling allowing unauthorized security gate traversal.
learning_objectives: Identify fail-open security flaws in exception handling blocks
Induce upstream failure states that bypass authorization checks
Enforce strict fail-closed defaults across all boundary guards

labs.title: Vertical Privilege Escalation & Header Role Manipulation
labs.description: Audit vertical privilege escalation vulnerabilities and manipulate custom HTTP role headers to access restricted admin operations.
labs.short_description: Vertical privilege escalation and header manipulation in OpsAdmin Portal.
learning_objectives: Identify missing role enforcement on privileged routes
Manipulate authorization headers to escalate access
Implement robust server-side RBAC validation

labs.title: Multi-Tenant Boundary Escape & Insecure Direct Object Deletion
labs.description: Exploit cross-tenant isolation gaps to delete resources and manipulate workspace scopes across isolated corporate tenants.
labs.short_description: Multi-tenant boundary escape and destructive IDOR in TenantCloud.
learning_objectives: Audit multi-tenant workspace isolation boundaries
Identify authorization bypasses in destructive HTTP methods
Enforce strict tenant scoping across all CRUD operations

labs.title: Insecure CORS Misconfiguration & Origin Reflection
labs.description: Exploit wildcard origin reflections and null origin trusts in CORS headers to exfiltrate private API keys.
labs.short_description: Insecure CORS origin reflection and credential exfiltration in APINexus Gateway.
learning_objectives: Analyze permissive Cross-Origin Resource Sharing headers
Craft malicious origin payloads to bypass regex filters
Configure safe explicit allowlists for cross-origin exchanges

labs.title: Exposed Git Directory & Object Carving Extraction
labs.description: Reconstruct commit history, tree blobs, and hardcoded production secrets from an exposed .git directory.
labs.short_description: Exposed version control repository and secret carving in DevBucket Storage.
learning_objectives: Detect publicly accessible version control directories
Extract staged commits and packfile blobs
Implement web server access control rules denying dotfile requests

labs.title: Dependency Confusion & Internal Namespace Hijacking
labs.description: Hijack unreserved internal organization package namespaces in public registries to trigger automated pipeline execution.
labs.short_description: Dependency confusion and namespace substitution in Enterprise Artifactory.
learning_objectives: Identify exposed internal package identifiers in manifests
Simulate public package version precedence attacks
Configure registry scoping and verification rules in package managers

labs.title: Malicious Preinstall Script & CI/CD Secret Exfiltration
labs.description: Analyze rogue preinstall lifecycle hooks exfiltrating environment variables and credentials during automated builds.
labs.short_description: Malicious lifecycle hooks and CI/CD secret harvesting in NodeBuild Engine.
learning_objectives: Audit package manifest lifecycle hook declarations
Detect outbound network exfiltration during package resolution
Enforce --ignore-scripts and isolated containerized build environments

labs.title: Predictable Password Reset Token via Insecure PRNG
labs.description: Reverse predictable pseudo-random number generator seeds to forge valid password reset tokens for high-privileged users.
labs.short_description: Predictable PRNG reset token generation in AuthKey Recovery Portal.
learning_objectives: Analyze non-cryptographic PRNG seed generation mechanisms
Predict sequential token outputs using timestamp offsets
Implement CSPRNG libraries for all security-sensitive tokens

labs.title: JWT Algorithm None & HMAC Weak Key Cracking
labs.description: Bypass signature validation using algorithm none injection and crack weak HMAC secrets offline to forge admin tokens.
labs.short_description: JWT algorithm none bypass and weak secret cracking in TokenShield SSO.
learning_objectives: Inspect JWT header parameters for algorithm confusion flaws
Crack low-entropy HMAC secret keys using dictionary techniques
Enforce strict asymmetric signature verification on backend brokers

labs.title: Blind Boolean & Time-Based SQL Injection
labs.description: Extract database schemas and records character-by-character using boolean inference and database sleep functions.
labs.short_description: Blind inference and time-based SQL injection in CustPortal Database.
learning_objectives: Identify blind SQL injection vectors without error output
Automate binary character extraction using conditional time delays
Apply parameterized queries and ORM abstractions defensively

labs.title: OS Command Injection via Unsanitized File Utilities
labs.description: Break out of shell command arguments using command separators and bypass basic character blacklists.
labs.short_description: Operating system command execution in CloudPing Diagnostic Console.
learning_objectives: Pinpoint shell invocation points in backend diagnostic scripts
Bypass whitespace and character filters to achieve command execution
Refactor shell executions to use safe parameterized process APIs

labs.title: Concurrency Race Condition & Double Spending
labs.description: Exploit Time-of-Check to Time-of-Use (TOCTOU) windows to redeem balances and promotional coupons multiple times.
labs.short_description: High-throughput coupon redemption race condition in FlashSale Pay.
learning_objectives: Identify transactional non-atomic check-then-act code patterns
Synchronize concurrent HTTP requests to trigger state collisions
Implement database row-level locking and distributed mutexes

labs.title: Multi-Step Workflow Step Skipping
labs.description: Bypass mandatory identity verification checkpoints by manipulating client navigation states and direct endpoint calls.
labs.short_description: KYC onboarding workflow bypass in Digital Banking Portal.
learning_objectives: Map multi-stage onboarding and transaction state transitions
Bypass verification steps by directly invoking completion routes
Enforce strict server-side finite state machines (FSM) for workflows

labs.title: OAuth 2.0 Account Linking Hijacking via Missing State
labs.description: Perform CSRF on OAuth callback flows lacking cryptographically secure state parameters to hijack target user profiles.
labs.short_description: OAuth 2.0 state validation omission and account takeover in SocialConnect Auth.
learning_objectives: Trace OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code exchange sequences
Exploit missing state parameters to attach attacker credentials
Enforce unguessable state tokens tied to pre-auth sessions

labs.title: MFA Bypass via Direct Endpoint Traversal
labs.description: Circumvent second-factor challenges through direct session state manipulation and incomplete backend step enforcement.
labs.short_description: Two-factor authentication step circumvention in TwoFactor SecureNet.
learning_objectives: Audit session transition states between primary and secondary auth
Bypass OTP challenges by directly accessing post-auth application endpoints
Implement multi-stage authentication tokens requiring full validation

labs.title: Unsigned Client-Side State Tampering in LocalStorage
labs.description: Tamper with unverified client-side session states, pricing parameters, and role claims stored insecurely in the browser.
labs.short_description: Client-side state manipulation and privilege forging in CartSync Session.
learning_objectives: Inspect insecure trust placed in client-controlled storage items
Manipulate user roles and checkout prices via browser storage
Sign client states cryptographically or migrate state strictly to server
prerequisites: A08 Software and Data Integrity Failures

labs.title: Python Pickle & YAML Unsafe Object Deserialization
labs.description: Construct malicious deserialization gadgets using Python __reduce__ and unsafe YAML loaders to gain remote code execution.
labs.short_description: Unsafe object deserialization leading to code execution in PipelineSerializer.
learning_objectives: Identify unsafe serialization libraries in data ingestion pipelines
Construct Python pickle payload gadgets for remote command execution
Replace executable serialization formats with pure JSON/Protocol Buffers

labs.title: CRLF Log Injection & Audit Trail Forgery
labs.description: Inject carriage return and line feed (CRLF) characters into log inputs to fake successful authentication and blind SIEM parsers.
labs.short_description: CRLF log injection and false audit trail injection in AuditSys Central.
learning_objectives: Trace unencoded user inputs into application event logging streams
Inject CRLF control sequences to forge authentic administrator log entries
Implement structured JSON logging and strict newline sanitization
prerequisites: A09 Security Logging and Monitoring Failures

labs.title: SIEM Threshold Evasion via Slow-and-Low Scanning
labs.description: Evade rate-based alerting rules and anomaly thresholds by modulating reconnaissance velocity and distributed origin headers.
labs.short_description: Detection rule evasion and stealth reconnaissance in StealthDetect Gateway.
learning_objectives: Analyze fixed-window velocity thresholds in security monitoring systems
Modulate attack cadence and distributed headers to avoid triggering alerts
Design composite and behavioral correlation rules beyond simple count thresholds

labs.title: Fail-Open Exception Handling in Auth Microservice
labs.description: Trigger null reference and timeout exceptions in boundary services to force authorization routines into permissive fail-open mode.
labs.short_description: Fail-open exception handling in GatewayGuard Perimeter.
learning_objectives: Audit catch-all exception blocks that default to permissive access states
Trigger upstream dependency faults to bypass authorization logic
Enforce strict fail-closed defaults and circuit breakers on error

labs.title: Full-Chain Blind SSRF to Cloud Metadata Services
labs.description: Bypass URL parsing sanitizers and DNS rebinding protections to pivot into cloud instance metadata endpoints (169.254.169.254).
labs.short_description: Full-chain blind SSRF to cloud metadata in WebFetch Microservice.
learning_objectives: Identify server-side URL fetching routines susceptible to SSRF
Bypass IP parsers using hexadecimal and decimal IP encodings
Deploy network-level egress filtering and IMDSv2 token enforcement
